free_tier.stated: No file size limit and no limit on number of transfers on the free web tier; no account required. Transfers above 2 GB are queued behind paid traffic.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered on the free tier (no per-GB line anywhere on the pricing page); free tier is ad-supported.

interface_detail: rest (official API + SDKs, but gated behind an API key) / web for the anonymous path
tooling: Official SDKs: @smash-sdk/uploader (npm), @smash-sdk/downloader, github.com/fromsmash/smash-uploader-js, smash-sdk-js, smash-downloader-js; docs api.fromsmash.com/docs/quick-start
chaining: Per-transfer model caps multiplication: unlimited transfers but each dies in 7 days. As storage it is a 7-day rolling window. N transfers/day x (size) x 7 days, nothing retained past 7. The API path (100 GB trial key x free accounts) is a 14-day trial, not perpetual.
limits_note: Retention 7 days on free (30 days paid). This is the binding constraint; no per-object-cap on the anonymous web tier; per-object behaviour beyond 2 GB is queue+deprioritisation not rejection; API keys are '100 GB, 14-day free trial (No credit card required)'. Trial, not free tier.
reliability_note: Free transfers are queued when >2 GB with no SLA on queue time; files are 'stored temporarily' on AWS regions and deleted at 7 days.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
